title: Mainsah et al. 2025 — bigP3BCI: An Open, Diverse and Machine Learning Ready P300-based Brain-Computer Interface Dataset (Study O)
description: Study O of the bigP3BCI collection, a large open P300-based brain-computer interface (BCI) speller dataset. It contains 32-channel EEG recorded at 256 Hz from 18 participants with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis across two sessions. Participants used a 9x8 character grid with a supervised checkerboard stimulus paradigm, and the data are annotated with target and non-target events. The dataset is formatted for machine-learning benchmarking with MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with g.USBamp amplifiers (g.tec) using 32 channels placed in a standard 10-20 montage at 256 Hz. Participants performed a visual P300 speller task on a 9x8 grid with online feedback in a laboratory setting. Calibration data were followed by test sessions, and events were labeled as Target or NonTarget with HED annotations.
